column6: City of the finest divine powers, lofty royal throne-dais! Shrine @wSN{Urim}, pre-eminent in @wGN{Sumer}, built in a pure place! City, your well-founded great wall has grown out of the @fsux{abzu}! City, beautiful as the sky, endowed with beauty, colourfully decorated in a great place! Shrine @wSN{Urim}, well-founded @fsux{ŋipar}, dwelling of @wDN{An} and @wDN{Enlil}! Your lofty palace is the @wTN{E-kiš-nu-ŋal}, in which the fates are determined! Your pilasters heavy with radiance tower over all the countries! Its terrace like a white cloud is a spectacle in the midst of heaven. Its …… like flashing lightning shines inside a shrine. Like a single bull under the yoke, ……. @wDN{Suen's} beloved pure table; @wTN{E-kiš-nu-ŋal}, @wDN{Suen's} beloved pure table. The king, ornament of the royal offering place, occupies the august courtyard; @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}} the exalted, whom no one dare oppose, ……. @wSN{Urim}, the wide city ……. @gap{1 line unclear}

……, the authoritative, praised himself exultantly: Under @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}}, king of @wSN{Urim}, for whom a favorable destiny was determined, the roads have been made passable. @wDN{An} opens his holy mouth, and because of me rain is produced. He directs it downward into the earth, and abundance is brought for me. @wDN{Enlil} treats me kindly, ……. @wDN{Enki} treats me kindly, bestowing early floods, grain and dappled barley. @wDN{Nintur} formed me; I am peerless. …… brought me up well; I am the king of the Land. I am ……; under my rule the cattle-pens and sheepfolds are extended wide. @wDN{Utu} endowed me with eloquence; my judgments create concord in @wGN{Sumer} and @wGN{Akkad}. @wDN{Ningublaga} has given me strength. In the whole extent of heaven and earth, no one can escape from a battle with me.

I am @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}}, king of @wSN{Urim}, the protecting genius of my city. I strike against those guilty of capital offences, and make them tremble. The fear I cause ……. My judgments make @wGN{Sumer} and @wGN{Akkad} follow a single path. I place my foot on the necks of thieves and criminals. I clamp down on evildoers, who will be caught like snakes. I …… fugitives, and their intentions will be set right. I make justice apparent; I defeat wickedness. As if I were fire, even my frowning is enough to create concord. My word ……. …… the lands, the foreign countries …… @wSN{Urim} ……. Their food offerings make @wDN{Nanna} rejoice in @wTN{E-kiš-nu-ŋal}.

After my seed had been poured into the holy womb, @wDN{Suen}, loving its appearance, made it partake of @wDN{Nanna's} attractiveness. Coming forth over the Land like @wDN{Utu}, @wDN{Enlil} called me by an auspicious name, and @wDN{Nintur} assisted at my birth. As I came forth from the womb of my mother @wDN{Ninsumun}, a favorable allotted destiny was determined for me.

In me, @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}}, the lands of @wGN{Sumer} and @wGN{Akkad} have their protecting genius. I am a source of joy for the Land; my life indeed creates! ……, the fields are resplendent under my rule. In the fields growing with ……, …… did not multiply under my rule. In the desert, the roads are made up as for a festival, and are passable because of me. The owner of the fields ……; it rises up to his chest. I have freed the sons of the poor from their duty of going to fetch firewood.

After the storm ……, and the month had been completed for me, @wDN{Enlil} chose me by extispicy on a day very auspicious for him. He spoke fairly to @wGN{Sumer}, and caused me to arise from my family. Because of my broad understanding and wisdom, @wDN{An} the king entrusted …… into my hands. I am the cosmic bond of @wGN{Sumer}. I am …… good ……. I am ……. I am …… of the Land. @gap{3 lines fragmentary} I, the lord, …….

I, @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}}, born on high, …… shining. The people line up in front of me. @wDN{Enlil} has given me the task of keeping the Land secure, with unscathed troops. I am clad in linen in the @fsux{ŋipar}. I lie down on the splendid bed in its delightful bedchamber. I cause the people to eat splendid food; I am their @wDN{Enkimdu} @noteref{i.e. the god of irrigation and cultivation}. I am the good shepherd whose sheep multiply greatly. I open the …… of the cattle-pens and sheepfolds. I am peerless. …… the pastures and watering-places of shepherds.

Since I have been adorned with their rulership, no one imposes taxes on my abundant crops which grow tall. My commands bring about joy in the great fortresses of the mountains. The joy of my city and the territory of @wGN{Sumer} delights me. I release water into the canals of @wGN{Sumer}, making the trees grow tall on their banks. I have lifted the yoke of its male prostitutes. @gap{1 line unclear}

After I had made the evil-doers return to their ……, I restored the walls that had been torn down; my outstanding mind ……. …… the shrine of @wSN{Urim} ……. …… at a banquet with me in the city. …… joyful dance ……. I have brought abundance to @wDN{Enlil's} temple on the king's canal: I have directed ships both to @wSN{Kar-ŋeština} of @wDN{Enlil} and to the lapis-lazuli quay of @wDN{Nanna}. Alcohol and syrup have been poured out before @wDN{Enlil}. To me, the shepherd @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}}, let life be given as a reward! For @wDN{Nanna}, my master, I have built his temple; as if it were a verdant hillside, I have set up the @wTN{E-kiš-nu-ŋal} in a great place. I have surrounded its terrace with a gold and lapis-lazuli fence.

I am the creature of @wDN{Nanna}! I am the older brother of @wDN{Gilgameš}! I am the son borne by @wDN{Ninsumun}, a princely seed! For me, kingship came down from heaven! Sweet is the praise of me, the shepherd @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}}!
